evidence.section: 3.3 Effect of brazing temperature on the joining properties of TZM/ZrCp-W brazed joints
evidence.quote: However, with increasing brazing temperature, many Ti(s, s) stripes emerge in the TZM substrate. As shown in Fig. 6 (d) and (e), these stripes are parallel to the interface between TZM and Ti(s, s) layer. Meanwhile, the stretch direction of most stripes coincides with the shear stress. Therefore, the shear strength decreases gradually when the brazing temperature exceeded 1040 °C.
